name: fig11_evaporation
caption: Quasi-static photon-only evaporation (L = sigma_SB A T_H^4, no greybody factors or other species): numerical integration vs the closed form, lifetime scaling and the adiabaticity parameter epsilon = (hbar/k_B T_H)|dM/dt|/M. The photon-only lifetime equals the age of the universe at M ~ 1.73e+11 kg. These lifetimes are approximations. epsilon grows as M^-2 but is still only 5.2e-04 at the Planck mass (it reaches 0.1 at 0.07 M_P), so this heuristic criterion does not locate the breakdown of the semiclassical picture; Planck-scale effects are expected earlier and are not modelled. The model is not extended to the endpoint.
